Cold wind brushes my face.

Laughter echoes in the air—

Laughter echoes.

Laughter echoes through the pines—  
Cold wind bites the air.

Snow-packed path winds low,  
Laughter echoes through the air—  
Speed glides, crisp and bright.

Snow-dusted path,  
Laughter echoes in the wind—  
Fast descent, joy bursts.

Snow-covered hill,  
Laughter echoes in the air—  
Speed glides down the slope.

Snowflakes swirl down fast,  
Laughter echoes on the hill—  
Winter's quick ride.
